intro: Systems Design Engineering at the University of Waterloo, working on embedded systems, robotics and computer vision - firmware, drivers and the boards they run on.

notes: Refactored two blocking functions into a producer-consumer model, offloading batched messaging to a worker thread.
Prototyped an encrypted image packaging pipeline, using tiarmhex to split ELFs into memory sections and TI's MetaImage Creator to merge them into an encrypted tri-core appimage.
Validated prefetch abort handler (asm), MPU memory zone protection, and OTP key loading on a TI mmWave target.
Extended the Python firewall config tool to a new chip, encoding user-defined permission regions into bytecode.
Optimized path planning algorithm, reducing imagery overlapping by 8% while maintaining > 95% aerial coverage.
Implemented Merkle Tree data structure to validate folders across servers to improve corruption checking efficiency.
Implemented CNN models with Dice Loss metric to benchmark multi-temporal RGB image change detection datasets.
Migrated 67 ATE tests to Linux and developed firmware regression tests like EEPROM error injection, validating AES encryption features and improving device driver reliability.
Designed a USB Linux driver to enable synchronized variable attenuator control for hardware-in-the-loop simulator.
Developed 17 C unit tests, achieved 100% CAN message module coverage, fixing defects and MISRA C violations.
Implemented an Arduino remote firmware flashing and debugging kits, enabling real-time trace logging over Wi-Fi.
Characterized loss rates and latency of CAN, LIN, and Ethernet communications utilizing Vector CANoe.
Led 50+ students to design, build, and test autonomous rover for annual competition; ranked 41 out of 108 teams.
Developed power distribution board firmware with CAN telemetry, featuring SoC Estimation, OVP, and OCP.
Developed an I2C resource manager on QNX RTOS featuring blocking and interrupt-driven (GPIO based) R/W.
Implemented Rocker-Bogie drivetrain kinematics with ROS joint trajectory controller with vel and pos commands.
Brought up multiple drone systems from scratch, configuring and integrating sensors (IMU, GPS, compass, optical flow), motor controller and flight controllers for testing and performance validation.
Designed a telemetry manager to handle MAVLink messaging protocol and decodes SBUS controller messages.
Designed a breakout PCB to convert GPIO headers to 6-pin JST-GH connector with Tx/Rx UART indicators.
Implemented I2C GPS NMEA protocol parsing driver on STM32, utilizing RTOS to achieve 1 Hz GPS data acquisition.
Won the BlackBerry Hardware Prize among 80+ competing teams and developed an IMU-based navigation node featuring extended Kalman filter and MQTT telemetry.
